author: GamingBolt
description:
I know what you're thinking when you see a new EA Sports FC game. Because I usually think the same thing. “Oh, this again?” Now, I'm sure the development team puts in the effort for changes, improvements, new features and whatnot, but when the result doesn't feel like a polished product, I don't know how to feel. 

Look at EA Sports FC 26. Playstyles and Roles are essentially the be-all, end-all when it comes to gameplay, and that's before delving into all the lackadaisical changes made to other modes at launch.
title: EA Sports FC 27 Looks Like It Could Finally Reward Skill Over Automation

author: GamingBolt
description:
Gears of War: E-Day is certainly high on the list of highly anticipated titles from a familiar franchise. The story taking us back to the early days of the human-Locust conflict was more than enough to have us hooked, but it looks like the Horde Mode is going to do a lot of the heavy lifting as far as keeping us coming back for more is concerned.

Taking on vicious waves of Locusts was always fun, but this one brings the cleanest take on the formula yet, while also weaving interesting changes and intelligent additions that expand its size and scope. 

Combine that with systems and mechanics that are a pleasure to engage with, and you have the makings of a hit. We’ve sunk a few hours into an early build of the Horde Mode, and are here to tell you why it’s a very exciting part of the upcoming title.
title: Gears of War E-Day's Horde Mode Is Unlike Anything We've Played Before

author: GamingBolt
description:
Beast of Reincarnation is getting more tempting with every passing day, and if you’re here, it's likely you’ve been drawn in by its melancholic world and the serene beauty that’s often disrupted by intense battles between Emma, Koo, and foes who are hell-bent on stopping the duo. 

Early previews of the game have given us new information, all of which makes us eager to dive into the fray. Of course, we’re not leaving you behind. Here’s everything new we’ve learned about a game that isn’t afraid to wear its inspirations on its sleeve while bringing enough fresh content to be an exciting addition to this year’s excellent lineup of titles.
title: Beast of Reincarnation - 15 NEW Things You Need To Know Before You Pre-Order
